problem: Could you provide more details about the projects listed on your resume? Specifically, what was your role and what kind of impact did your contributions have?
referenceAnswer:
One of the projects that I'm most proud of is an AI interview preparation service.
In this project, the biggest challenge was improving the AI grading process.
At first, grading was processed immediately whenever a user submitted an answer.
This worked well when the number of concurrent users was small.
However, as concurrent requests increased, too many grading tasks were submitted to the thread pool at once.
I tried tuning the grading thread pool to scale quickly, but under high concurrency, the thread pool still started rejecting tasks.
This made me realize that immediate grading had a structural limitation because the system could not control the amount of incoming work.
So I redesigned it as scheduled grading. The system first saves the grading request, and then processes grading jobs asynchronously in the background.
As a result, throughput increased from 8 TPS to 231 TPS and p95 latency dropped from 20 seconds to 1.5 seconds.
From this experience, I learned how to design systems that stay stable even if traffic increases.
